rule.cohort: DL, 8+ random NFL pass-rush starts set at the snap, 100+ career rushes
rule.first_step: mean speed 0.3-0.5 s after first movement (speed first >= 1 yd/s minus 0.2 s), alignment-adjusted
rule.stopwatch: official 40 time, year-standardized, residual on weight z and EDGE share
rule.adjust: residual on Combine weight z and EDGE share, standardized
rule.forecast: rush-weighted least squares of shrunk pressure rate on log pick (UDFA 262), weight z, EDGE share; fit on prior classes
rule.test: binomial slope with logit(forecast) offset in the new class; one-sided p < 0.05, for the 40 time and the first step
rule.cutoffs: set on the previous classes only (top third of first step, top half of 40 time)
rule.both: first step top third and 40 time top half
rule.start_only: first step top third, 40 time bottom half or none
rule.speed_only: first step bottom third, 40 time top half
rule.neither: first step bottom third, 40 time bottom half or none

data_used: 2023-2025 regular seasons only; no 2026 data on disk
test: 2026 season, rushers with 100+ 2026 rushes; hit = 2026 pressure rate above persistence forecast (own 2023-25 pressure shrunk to pick/weight/role forecast); list vs rest of pool; one-sided Fisher exact p < 0.05; secondary: frozen first-step slope with persistence offset, one-sided p < 0.05
matched_pairs_2026: each list member vs nearest-pick non-list rusher of same class and role; share of pairs with higher 2026 pressure rate > 50%
